content: 9front has the only maintained Plan 9 aarch64 libc at sys/src/libc/arm64/ (github.com/9front/9front branch 'front'): _seek.c argv0.s atom.s atomic.s atomic64.s cycles.s fabs.s floor.s getcallerpc.s getfcr.s lock.c main9.s main9p.s memmove.s memset.s mkfile notejmp.c setjmp.s sqrt.s tas.s. Portable libc stays shared in libc/port, libc/9sys, libc/fmt. Per-arch headers at arm64/include/{u.h,ureg.h,ape/}. Verified by direct fetch.
